scope: Independent review of NaN/rounding/sign injection relevant to actual counterexamples and proposed public math model. Full intrinsic contract ledger and kernel proof are not complete.

environment.ARM: AArch64 binary32, RNE, DN=0, FZ=0, FIZ=0, AH=0, traps disabled, FP/QC flags not observed
environment.RVV: V1.0 + F2.2, RNE canonical arithmetic NaNs, VXRM RDN for shift0 clips, VLEN128 with VLMAX32 in e8m2/e32m8; no observation of inactive lanes

findings.ARM: With the stated FPCR and finite converted integer first operand, FPMul propagates the scale NaN and FPAdd retains it. Sign and payload remain, with signaling payload quieting. Invalid0*Inf produces positive default NaN.
findings.RVV: Vector arithmetic follows scalar NaN rules and produces positive canonical NaN. vfsgnj.vf copies scalar sign without arithmetic canonicalization. Place sign repair after the last vfadd.
findings.repair: Keep NEON unchanged. RVV uses magic-bias bit reinterpret and signed saturating subtraction, restoring the NaN scale sign after final arithmetic. Quantization then depends on NaN sign, while payload differences saturate away.

missing: Full per-intrinsic C contract and exact-call binding ledger
Actual annotated kernels, memory/ordinary-adapter/caller closure and full fresh gate

mathematical_relation_evidence.claim: Actual public mathematical definitions match for every binary32 scale and signed16 zero point; still not actual C kernel or ISA correspondence proof
